author: mara
story: Tomas, who covers the CEE countries, writes the weekly digest for the Czech Republic: faulted charge points joined with open tickets in code, written up by the smart model, and then posted to his team's Teams channel through ctx.confirm, which he confirms.

input.text: Weekly digest CZ: faulted chargers and open tickets are listed in the ops digest app. Chargers without a ticket get one today.
